screens.name: Midcap Opportunity
screens.rubric: Identify midcap compounders with resilient revenue growth, healthy cash conversion, and reasonable valuations.

screens.name: Super High Growth Companies in Long Term
screens.rubric: Verify sustained high growth (>20% 3Y/5Y CAGR) with strong balance sheet, cash conversion (>70%), and reinvestment moat.

screens.name: Bruised Bluechips
screens.rubric: Verify whether the PE discount vs 5Y median is temporary cyclical/sentiment pressure rather than structural moat decay.
